directive.quote: use it, and move the tool one to one under tools/.

old_copy.deleted_with: Old Worker retirement removed its source owners.

preserve: Normalize and deduplicate audience sources, subtract exclusions, page delivery and retain per-channel typed outcomes.
Claim a delivery before linking or sending; persist possible dispatch before the effect and never replay an unknown result.
Recheck current channel definitions, shareability, eligibility and opt-outs before every effect.
Import actual receipts without replacing attempts, and derive results from link and experiment owners.
allowed_deltas: Use the existing content-identity BLAKE3 owner; preserve the old 24-character delivery identity and unprefixed channel identity.
All record and host reads/writes are awaited. Claims and subsequent writes compare the exact observed record through the existing records door; a unique claim token fences a stale process.
Runtime channel choices, timings, words and screen descriptions are read from rows. Immutable protocol and bounded delivery settings retain their old values.
No legacy channel definition is inferred when an old receipt lacks its accepted identity; create a new send instead.
Native sharing, list/rule, scheduling, experiment and effect interfaces are explicit host supplies. This module does not claim those missing installed bindings.
banned_substitutions: A second store, hash owner, scheduler or provider sender.
Content defaults written into source files or a tool completion treated as delivery acknowledgement.
